newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka recovers on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka recovers on dollar supply.

text.p: Selling of the U.S. currency by two major state-owned banks spurred a recovery of the local unit by midday in interbank trading on Monday, dealers said.
Taka finished at Sunday's level at 44.2050/2100 against an opening quotation of 44.2000/2200.
"There was heavy buying (of dollars) by importers throughout the session, but selling by state-owned banks largely offset the pressure on taka," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed slightly higher at 7.5 to 8.0 percent against a previous 7.0 to 7.5 percent as dollar demand caused increased borrowing in the call market.
